versions.changelog:
- Expanded documentation in SKILL.md with detailed quick start, install notes, and usage workflows.
- Added step-by-step examples for each Tavily and Exa app, covering search, extraction, and direct answers.
- Included recommended workflows for research + LLM (RAG pipelines) and extract + summarize tasks.
- Added a comprehensive use cases section and related skills integrations.
- Improved clarity on available tools, triggers, and app descriptions.

- No changes detected in this release.
- Version number updated to 0.1.1.

Initial release of web-search skill with Tavily and Exa integration via inference.sh CLI.

- Provides AI-powered web search, extraction, and direct factual answers.
- Supports Tavily and Exa apps for search, extract, and Q&A tasks.
- Includes workflows for research, content extraction, RAG pipelines, and summarization.
- Example command-line usage and integration with LLMs are documented.
- Highlights use cases: research, fact-checking, content aggregation, and building agents.
